sources.title: Rays of Fire (Cantrip)
markers: | description = Hurl 3 rays of fire. Each ray deals {{DamageText|3d6|Fire}} damage.

summary: Gain +1 Strength saves, spell attack rolls and spell save DC. Add Fire to weapon hits or Necrotic to unarmed hits.

fields.Infernal Touch: Weapon hits add 1d6 Fire. Unarmed hits add 1d6 Necrotic and force DC 15 Constitution against Bleeding for 2 turns.
fields.Rays of Fire: Action once per Short Rest. Make three ranged spell attacks up to 60 ft away. Each ray deals 3d6 Fire on a hit.
fields.Base value: 540 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Infernal Acuity: +1 spell save DC. The tooltip shows +1 to spell attack rolls, but the pinned source reports it applies to all attack rolls.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
